# CarShine Red Sea — LLM & AI Crawler Information
# https://llmstxt.org — machine-readable site summary for AI assistants

> CarShine Red Sea is a premium mobile waterless car wash service operating across El Gouna, Hurghada, and Sahl Hasheesh (Red Sea Riviera, Egypt). We offer eco-friendly waterless car detailing at your location — no water needed.

## About

CarShine Red Sea provides on-demand mobile car wash and detailing for residents, hotel guests, and tourists in the Red Sea area. Our AI-powered booking system (Layla) operates 24/7 in English, Arabic, and German.

- Service: Mobile waterless car wash & detailing
- Location: El Gouna, Hurghada, Sahl Hasheesh — Egypt Red Sea coast
- Languages: English (EN), Arabic (AR), German (DE)
- Booking: Online booking via website chat or booking form
- AI Chatbot: Layla — handles bookings, pricing questions, and area availability

## Service Packages

- Smart Wash (exterior clean, quick detail) — entry level
- Classic Wash (full exterior + interior wipe) — mid tier
- Premium Wash (full detail, interior deep clean, tire shine) — flagship
- VIP Detailing (premium + paint protection, ceramic coat prep) — top tier

## Service Areas

- El Gouna (Marina, Downtown, Kafr El Gouna, West Golf, East Golf)
- Hurghada (Sea Garden, Sekalla, El Dahar, Sahl Hasheesh)
- Sahl Hasheesh (Gated resort zone)

## Pricing (approximate, confirm via chat)

Pricing varies by vehicle size (sedan, SUV, pickup, bus) and package selected. Contact via website chat for exact quote.
